title: HDFC Bank App Needs Serious Improvement
text:
The HDFC Bank app needs significant improvement, especially for business users who make multiple payments to vendors daily.

1. Limited access to payment confirmation and screenshots: The option to download or share transaction details is available immediately after making a payment. However, if I forget to download the confirmation at that moment, I have to rely on the Recent Transactions section to find the payment later. Taking a direct screenshot of the transaction on my iPhone results in a blank image, so I cannot use that as an alternative.
2. Recent transactions are not displayed reliably: After making multiple payments, sometimes only one or two transactions appear in the Recent Transactions section, while others are missing. This makes it difficult to retrieve payment proof and share it with vendors, creating unnecessary inconvenience in daily business operations.
3. No access to the current day’s bank statement: There should be an option to view or download a statement for the current date, including all transactions made that day. Business users need this feature to verify payments and provide transaction proof without having to hand over their phones to someone else.
4. Persistent error message during transactions: I am using an iPhone 15 Pro Max running iOS 27, and an error message appears every time I make a transaction. I have to tap “OK” repeatedly, which is frustrating and disrupts the payment process.

These are basic banking features that should work reliably, particularly for customers using the app for daily business transactions. HDFC Bank needs to improve payment confirmation access, ensure all transactions appear correctly in the transaction history, provide same-day statement access, and fix the recurring technical error.

Please take customer feedback seriously and resolve these issues as soon as possible.

title: Serious Privacy and Data Security Concern – Third-Party Access to Financial Information Through iMob
text:
Dear ICICI Bank Team,

I would like to raise a serious concern regarding the feature in the iMobile app that allows customers to share their confidential financial information with external entities such as Setu and iFinance through the “Track All My Expenses” feature.

This raises significant concerns about customer privacy, financial data security, and consent.

If a customer knowingly or unknowingly clicks on this feature, it may initiate the process of sharing sensitive financial information with a third-party entity, potentially allowing access to account details and transaction history for tracking and analysing expenses.

My concerns are:

1. Data Privacy: Why should customers’ confidential banking and transaction information be shared with external commercial entities?
2. Informed Consent: A customer may accidentally click on this feature without fully understanding the extent of data access being granted.
3. Misuse of Customer Data: Customers may subsequently receive unwanted marketing calls and promotional offers for financial products and insurance policies.
4. Security Risks: Providing third-party access to sensitive financial information increases the potential risk of data misuse and privacy breaches.

I strongly request ICICI Bank to:

* Remove or disable this feature by default.
* Stop sharing customers’ financial information with external entities without explicit, informed and granular consent.
* Provide a clear option to revoke third-party access and permanently delete previously shared financial data.
* Ensure that customer financial information is never used for unsolicited marketing or cross-selling activities.

A customer’s financial data is confidential and must be treated as such. Banking trust should never be compromised for third-party business partnerships or commercial interests.

Please prioritise customer privacy and information security over business opportunities involving customer financial data.

I request the bank to review this feature and take appropriate action to protect its customers.

Regards,
A Concerned ICICI Bank Customer

title: Lost Trust Due to Repeated Account Blocks
text:
I have completely lost trust in this bank. Banking should make life easier, but with Kotak I constantly feel restricted. I am always worried about whether my account will be blocked when I use my own money.

My account has been blocked multiple times for what I believe are normal transactions, such as transferring money, withdrawing cash, or using my own balance. I receive generic messages saying my transactions do not align with my account profile, but I am never given a clear explanation of what I did wrong or how to prevent it from happening again.

The worst part is the uncertainty. I no longer feel confident keeping money in this account because I never know when it will be blocked or when I will lose access to my own funds. It has reached a point where I hesitate to deposit money because I fear another restriction.

Customer support has not provided a satisfactory solution, and the repeated restrictions have made everyday banking stressful instead of convenient. I understand that banks need security systems to prevent fraud, but genuine customers should not feel like they need permission to use their own money.

Unfortunately, I have lost trust in Kotak and no longer feel comfortable using it as my primary bank. I sincerely hope Kotak improves its fraud detection systems, communicates clearly with customers, and ensures legitimate users are not repeatedly inconvenienced.

title: Feature Request: Option to Mark Bills as Paid Elsewhere
text:
Hello Kotak 811 Team,

I have been using the Kotak 811 app as my primary banking app for daily transactions and bill payments, and I genuinely appreciate how smooth, clean, and easy to use it is.

I would like to suggest a feature that I believe would improve the bill payment experience.

Currently, if I pay a bill using another platform (for example, another banking app, UPI app, or directly on the biller’s website), the bill continues to appear as pending in the Kotak 811 app. It would be very helpful if users could manually mark a bill as “Paid Elsewhere” or “Already Paid”.

This feature could:

* Hide the bill until the next billing cycle.
* Help users keep track of which bills have already been settled.
* Reduce confusion and avoid accidental duplicate payments.
* Make the app a better bill management tool in addition to being a payment platform.

I believe many users who use multiple payment methods would find this feature valuable.

Thank you for building such a great app and for considering this suggestion.

Kind regards,
Vignesh

title: Do not open an account in this pathetic bank!!!!
text:
Bank of Baroda Customer Service — 1/5
Bank of Baroda’s customer service is honestly one of the most frustrating banking experiences I’ve encountered. The biggest problem is the complete lack of ownership. Customer care, branches and different departments seem incapable of communicating with one another, leaving the customer to act as the middleman.
What is even more ridiculous is the apparent inability to handle bank-to-bank communication efficiently. If another bank needs to communicate with Bank of Baroda regarding an account or transaction, you can end up being asked to coordinate the process yourself. In an age of instant digital banking, this is simply unacceptable.

And then comes account closure—a process that feels like it belongs in the 19th century. Despite being able to open and operate accounts digitally, customers can be required to physically visit their home branch to close an account. If you have moved cities, or simply no longer live near that branch, apparently that is your problem.

There is nothing wrong with proper verification or security. But requiring customers to physically travel to a specific branch when secure digital verification and centralized processing are clearly possible is unnecessarily bureaucratic and incredibly inconvenient.

The overall experience is:

Call customer care → get redirected to the branch → contact the home branch → submit documents → wait → follow up → escalate → repeat.

Bank of Baroda is a major modern bank operating with technology that should make banking effortless, yet its customer-service processes often feel decades behind.
